_about: Recorded third-party keyword evidence consumed by scripts/english-seo-matrix.js (Evidence column). Every figure below was returned by a named tool on the stated date; nothing is estimated or extrapolated. Google Search Console for en.rentbikehanoi.com is still not connected (OpenRush and OpenSEO both report no connected property), so no first-party click/impression data exists for the English site yet.

_source.tool: Ubersuggest keyword_suggestions (free tier, global English, no location filter)
calls: seeds: motorbike rental hanoi | scooter rental hanoi | monthly motorbike rental hanoi
seeds: rent motorbike hanoi | motorbike rental vietnam | motorbike rental hanoi old quarter
OpenSEO get_keyword_metrics (DataForSEO, United States, English) 2026-10-14 — 40 keywords requested, 19 returned with data
OpenRush inspect_serp motorbike rental hanoi (United States) 2026-10-14
notes: volume = Ubersuggest monthly search volume (global); pd = paid difficulty; sd (SEO difficulty) was not returned on the free tier.

Ubersuggest reports 0 volume for 'monthly motorbike rental hanoi', 'long term motorbike rental vietnam' and '50cc motorbike rental vietnam'. A zero here means the tool has no data, not proof of zero demand; owner history records monthly rental as a recurring real enquiry theme (docs/CUSTOMER-INTENTS.md).
Competitor brand-name queries returned by the tool (other rental shops) are deliberately not recorded.
OpenSEO/DataForSEO volumes are US-market only and therefore much lower than the global Ubersuggest figures; both are recorded, neither is extrapolated.
Google Search Console is not connected on OpenRush or OpenSEO (checked 2026-10-14); an OpenSEO project exists for the domain so GSC can be connected later.
